step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts and open the Agreement Document.

Extract data from the document using Contract Intelligence by clicking Review Import Results. For more information on data extraction, see Extracting Agreement Data Using Contract Intelligence for CLM.
In the Contracts pane, click the Work tab and click Doc Clauses. The list of extracted clauses is displayed.

Highlight the text that you want to re-mark, select the incorrectly tagged doc clauses and click the more button (), and click Re-Mark. A confirmation dialog appears. This unmarks the doc clause and retains its content as plain text.
